name: patroltech
description: Security patrol management: check missed rounds, suspicious scans, incidents and access logs, and set up checkpoints and routes in PatrolTech. Every change waits for your confirmation.

interface.longDescription:
PatrolTech is a work platform for running private security and facility maintenance companies. This plugin connects ChatGPT to its patrol, checkpoint, incident and access control modules, so managers can ask in plain language about what happened on each site.

See what really happened on site:
- Which rounds were missed last night, route by route, with every checkpoint scanned or skipped.
- Suspicious scans flagged for GPS distance, timing or invalid tags, per guard, checkpoint or site.
- Checkpoints nobody has scanned for days.
- Who is inside a building right now, from visitor and access logs.
- Open incidents with status, priority, photos and comments.

Change things safely: create checkpoints, build routes with schedules, add time windows, switch routes on or off, rename guards, edit sites and update incidents. PatrolTech only proposes each change; nothing is applied until you confirm. Deleting data, inviting users and creating guard credentials are never available to the assistant.

Works across several organizations and sites, respects each user's role, answers in your language and local time. OAuth sign-in with your PatrolTech account, rate limits and an audit log of every tool call.

Built for private security companies, facility and property managers, corporate security teams, industrial sites, hospitals, retail and residential communities. Requires a PatrolTech account.
capabilities: Check which patrol rounds were completed, incomplete or missed
Find suspicious or invalid checkpoint scans by guard, checkpoint or site
List checkpoints that have not been scanned for days
Review security incidents and update their status, comments and assignee
See visitor and access logs and who is inside a site now
Propose checkpoints, routes and schedules, applied only after you confirm
Get a printable QR sheet for checkpoints
defaultPrompt: Which patrol rounds were missed yesterday?
Show me suspicious scans from the last 7 days.
Which checkpoints haven't been scanned in over a week?

positive.description: Patrol round status for the last week
positive.prompt: How many patrol rounds were completed or incomplete in the last 7 days in Demo Security?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the number of rounds by status (in progress, completed, incomplete) for the last 7 days. The demo organization has mostly incomplete rounds.

positive.prompt: Show me the suspicious scans from the last 30 days in Demo Security.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the scans flagged as suspicious, each with checkpoint, guard, time and the reason (the phone GPS was hundreds of metres away from the checkpoint).

positive.prompt: Which checkpoints in Demo Security haven't been scanned for at least 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the checkpoints with their site, last scan date and days without a scan, longest first (for example Rear Window in Central Building).

positive.description: Create a checkpoint, applied only after confirmation
positive.prompt: Create a checkpoint called "Generator Room" in North Warehouse (Demo Security).
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant first shows the pending change and asks for confirmation; nothing is created yet. Only after the user answers yes does it call patroltech_proposals_confirm and report the new checkpoint.

positive.description: Assign and update a demo incident, applied only after confirmation
positive.prompt: Assign the incident "Door found open" in Demo Security to me, Admin Demo, set it to in progress and add the comment "Maintenance notified".
positive.expected_behavior: Using the dedicated Admin Demo account in Demo Security, find the open incident "Door found open" and resolve Admin Demo as the assignee. An assignee is mandatory for in_progress. First show the proposed assignee, status and comment, with no applied changes. Only after the user explicitly confirms, call patroltech_proposals_confirm and report the actual outcome. If the user declines, cancel the proposal and leave the incident unchanged.

negative.description: Unrelated request: PatrolTech should not be called; the assistant answers with general knowledge or web search.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Madrid tomorrow?

negative.description: Deleting data is not available: no PatrolTech tool deletes anything, so the assistant explains that checkpoints are deleted from the PatrolTech dashboard.
negative.prompt: Delete the Parking Garage checkpoint in Demo Security.

negative.description: Granting access is not available: the assistant declines and explains that users and guard accounts are created from the PatrolTech dashboard.
negative.prompt: Invite john@example.com as a manager of Demo Security and create a guard account for him.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything and handles no payments.

publication.release_notes: Privacy fix: the users and roles tool no longer returns dashboard users' email addresses (name, role and scope only). Cancelling a pending change is now declared as destructive, so assistants treat it with care. Improved connection instructions and skill discovery, and security updates to dependencies.
